macros.name: addresswidth
macros.doc: Both the sending address and the closing will be set at in a box of width \addresswidth; the box is flush right, the material within the box is flush left.

macros.name: anlage
macros.doc: Enclosures are indicated by the \anlage command, which calls the standard \encl macro.

macros.name: anrede
macros.doc: The opening and closing of a letter are called by macros named for the German equivalents to \opening and \closing, namely \anrede and \gruss.

macros.name: datum
macros.doc: The date itself can be entered with the \datum command, and the \heute macro produces the current date in German format.

macros.name: gruss
macros.doc: The command \gruss ends a letter by first adding some whitespace and disabling further pagebreaks.

macros.name: heute
macros.doc: The date itself can be entered with the \datum command, and the \heute macro produces the current date in German format.

macros.name: ort
macros.doc: \ort is equivalent to \location, and can be used to provide the place name on the dateline.

macros.name: unterschrift
macros.doc: \unterschrift provides the signature after the closing.

envs.name: brief
envs.doc: The environment for a German letter is, appropriately enough, named brief (the German word for letter).
